newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RBA says no more quarterly reports on economy.
newsitem.headline: RBA says no more quarterly reports on economy.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia said the semi-annual statement on monetary policy, the first of which was released on May 8, had replaced the quarterly reports on the economy which the bank previously produced.
This meant the May issue of the RBA Bulletin released Monday contained a copy of the bank's statement on monetary policy but no quarterly report, as some in the market had expected.
No more quarterly reports would be released and the next semi-annual statement was scheduled for November, a bank spokesman said.
